title: Extra Napkins
premise: The pizza guy says, 'Extra napkins are in the bag.' He unzips it. Napkins blast out like a confetti cannon and fill the hallway to the ceiling. He walks off. Lillith and Rubella are two heads above a napkin sea.
visual: Apartment doorway. The pizza guy in his red uniform and cap holds an insulated bag erupting a white fountain of napkins. The hall is chin-deep in napkins. Lillith and Rubella are just two heads and one pizza box above the white drift, perfectly flat. He is checking his phone.
characterLean: Callback: 'Extra napkins are in the bag.' (always said, always true). Pizza Guy never flinches and never looks at it. The Two never react. The world is the silly part.
